code.script:
import pandas as pd
import torch


# Generating a random sample of 100 1D numbers
tensor_1d = torch.rand(100)

# Generating a random sample of 10000 2D numbers
tensor_2d = torch.rand(100, 100)

# Generating a sample of 1000000 3D numbers
tensor_3d = torch.rand(100, 100, 100)

# Creating a dataframe with the generated tensors
df = pd.DataFrame(
    tensor_2d
)

# Saving the dataframe into a .csv for registry
csv_text = df.to_csv(index=False)



# Name of the dataset.
name = "tensor_dataset"

# Description of the dataset.
description = "Template dataset based on Tensors generated using PyTorch and Pandas"

# Object type. To define the payload to be used in the dataset.
object_type = "dataset"

# Path of the dataset. Between, generated, model and dataset.
path = "generated/numerical_tensor_dataset.csv"

# Version of the dataset. To be used in further updates on the dataset.
version = 1

# Dataset type. Between, numerical, categorical, time series, image, videoaudio, text, mixed.
dataset_type = "numerical_dataset"

# Connection string. To be used in datasets that use live updates.
connection_string = ""
